description: No mechanism exists to verify the identity of data subjects making rights requests when reasonable doubts exist. Verification must balance security with accessibility of rights.
applicability: Applicable to data subject rights request handling where identity verification is needed. Must not create unnecessary barriers to exercising rights.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through review of identity verification procedures for rights requests. Assess whether verification is proportionate and does not unduly burden data subjects.

sources.title: GDPR - Regulation (EU) 2016/679
sources.section: Chapter III - Rights of the Data Subject

sources.title: EDPB Guidelines on Data Subject Rights
